scope: Static source evidence only; no live firmware attestation, physical readback or hardware validation

semantics.get: 0F/82 selector1,5 selects persistent keyboard state; writes mode, direction and speed at payload2,3,4 while retaining request DataSize
semantics.getDirectionForm: DataSize4 payload01 05 00 00 reveals direction within declared response; all90 transport bytes are transferred
semantics.getSpeedForm: DataSize5 also includes speed; Wave SET defaults stored speed to40, so expect nonzero28
semantics.set: 0F/02 Wave consumes payload3 unconditionally; omission is not preserve-current-direction semantics
semantics.shortSet: A zero-padded three-byte SET supplies wire direction0 from padding; do not use omission as unknown direction
semantics.preserveSet: Retain reviewed four-byte01 05 04 01 destination; no speed byte required by this image
semantics.admission: No DataSize comparison occurs along the reviewed fixed90-byte receive, class dispatch and Wave GET/SET paths
semantics.alternateDirectionReadback: Wire2 has an explicit cyclic phase branch opposite to admittedwire1. Treat it as a known alternate read-only baseline; this evidence adds no write2 or physical orientation claim. Other raw values remain outside the bounded application admission.

proofSites.meaning: USB SET_REPORT copies all 90 bytes into frame 0x10001740; no payload DataSize test
USB GET_REPORT copies all 90 bytes from response frame
Class dispatch reads frame byte6 and selects class0F
Response path XORs bytes2 through87 and sets successful status; preserves DataSize
Effect handler reads frame command7 and selectors8/9; no header DataSize read before GET/SET dispatch
GET82 validates LED, clears payload2..11, normalizes storage, selects state, reads state effect+5
GET effect compact switch and inline table
Wave GET stores effect4 at payload2, direction state+10 at payload3, speed at payload4; returns without DataSize change
SET selects stored/volatile state and switches on payload2
Wave SET validates LED and compares actual payload3 with current direction
Wave SET stores effect4 and actual payload3; hardcodes speed40; does not read speed argument
State selector returns matching LED bank pointer
Compact switch helper validates count and doubles destination offsets
Off, Breathing and Spectrum GET branches never write payload3 after common clearing; return fourth byte zero
Wave renderer dispatch indexes active-state effect byte5
Wave case loads direction state+0A into argument1 and callsA780
Wave consumer explicitly increments cyclic phase for wire2; decrements for other values including admittedwire1
